system.description:
At the beginning of a session, place
tokens equal to your Interface trait on
this card.
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Far range and spend any number
of tokens to release a concentrated
burst of unstable code, signal noise, or
weaponized feedback against them.
On a success, roll a number of d6s
equal to the tokens spent and deal that
much techno damage to the target.
Mark a Stress to replenish this card
with tokens, up to your Interface trait.
At the end of each session, clear all
unspent tokens.
